patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,100 @@
-class RestAPI:
-    def __init__(self, database: dict | None = None):
-        pass
-
-    def get(self, url: str, payload: str | None = None) -> str:
-        pass
-
-    def post(self, url: str, payload: str | None = None) -> str:
-        pass
+import json
+
+class RestAPI:
+    def __init__(self, database: dict | None = None):
+        self.database = database or {"users": []}
+
+    def get(self, url: str, payload: str | None = None) -> str:
+        if url == "/users":
+            if payload is None:
+                # Return all users
+                users = [self._create_user_object(user) for user in self.database["users"]]
+                return json.dumps({"users": users})
+            else:
+                # Return specified users
+                data = json.loads(payload)
+                user_names = data.get("users", [])
+                users = [self._create_user_object(user) for user in self.database["users"] if user["name"] in user_names]
+                users.sort(key=lambda x: x["name"])
+                return json.dumps({"users": users})
+        return json.dumps({})
+
+    def post(self, url: str, payload: str | None = None) -> str:
+        if url == "/add":
+            data = json.loads(payload)
+            user_name = data["user"]
+            # Check if user already exists
+            for user in self.database["users"]:
+                if user["name"] == user_name:
+                    return json.dumps(self._create_user_object(user))
+            # Create new user
+            new_user = {"name": user_name, "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}}
+            self.database["users"].append(new_user)
+            return json.dumps(self._create_user_object(new_user))
+        elif url == "/iou":
+            data = json.loads(payload)
+            lender_name = data["lender"]
+            borrower_name = data["borrower"]
+            amount = data["amount"]
+            
+            # Find lender and borrower
+            lender = None
+            borrower = None
+            for user in self.database["users"]:
+                if user["name"] == lender_name:
+                    lender = user
+                if user["name"] == borrower_name:
+                    borrower = user
+            
+            if lender is None or borrower is None:
+                return json.dumps({})
+            
+            # Update lender's owed_by and borrower's owes
+            lender["owed_by"][borrower_name] = lender["owed_by"].get(borrower_name, 0) + amount
+            borrower["owes"][lender_name] = borrower["owes"].get(lender_name, 0) + amount
+            
+            # Handle offsetting debts
+            if lender_name in borrower["owed_by"]:
+                lender_owes_borrower = borrower["owed_by"][lender_name]
+                borrower_owes_lender = lender["owed_by"][borrower_name]
+                
+                if lender_owes_borrower > borrower_owes_lender:
+                    # Net amount borrower owes lender
+                    net_amount = lender_owes_borrower - borrower_owes_lender
+                    del lender["owed_by"][borrower_name]
+                    del borrower["owed_by"][lender_name]
+                    borrower["owes"][lender_name] = net_amount
+                    del lender["owes"][borrower_name]
+                elif borrower_owes_lender > lender_owes_borrower:
+                    # Net amount lender owes borrower
+                    net_amount = borrower_owes_lender - lender_owes_borrower
+                    del lender["owed_by"][borrower_name]
+                    del borrower["owed_by"][lender_name]
+                    lender["owed_by"][borrower_name] = net_amount
+                    del borrower["owes"][lender_name]
+                else:
+                    # Debts cancel out
+                    del lender["owed_by"][borrower_name]
+                    del borrower["owed_by"][lender_name]
+                    del lender["owes"][borrower_name]
+                    del borrower["owes"][lender_name]
+            
+            # Return updated user objects
+            updated_users = [
+                self._create_user_object(lender),
+                self._create_user_object(borrower)
+            ]
+            updated_users.sort(key=lambda x: x["name"])
+            return json.dumps({"users": updated_users})
+        return json.dumps({})
+
+    def _create_user_object(self, user_data):
+        owes = user_data["owes"]
+        owed_by = user_data["owed_by"]
+        balance = sum(owed_by.values()) - sum(owes.values())
+        return {
+            "name": user_data["name"],
+            "owes": owes,
+            "owed_by": owed_by,
+            "balance": round(balance, 2)
+        }
